name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.0 Standalone
author: James
description: Major standalone Velvet Antenna release consolidating the working 0.10/0.12/0.14/0.15/0.17 behaviour into one mod. Adds a stable settled Home hero, exact local playback handoff, native Series/Season support, genuine Jellyfin library tabs and subtitles, premium search/library/detail/player styling, future Live TV presentation and administrator metadata-management controls for fixing unmatched media directly from library cards.
